caption: The drawing depicts a single metal object placed centrally on a plain, off-white or beige background. The object consists of a round, flat base with subtle, shaded detailing to suggest a metallic texture and depth. Rising vertically from each side of the base are two thin wire arms, which curve outwards and then inwards, connected at the top by another piece of wire forming a loop, suggesting a handle or hanger. On the base, slightly off-center, there is a cylindrical, cap-like component, and adjacent to it, lying on its side, is a smaller cylindrical object resembling a lid. The entire drawing is rendered in grayscale pencil, with careful use of shading to create a three-dimensional effect and show the contours and metallic surface of the depicted item. There is a faint signature, “Helen Hobart,” in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Lantern
